  and wine)  for on-site  consumption  in conjunction  with  an existing

  Avenue  (the "SoFive  Soccer  Complex").

EMAILS  The City  Clerk  stated receiving  a total of thirteen  emails.  Nine  of which
  were in support  of the alcohol  sales at SoFive  and three emails  opposing
  the proposals.  Additionally,  there was one email  that was neither  in
  support  nor in opposition  to the matter.  This  email  was from  Claudia,  and
  she criticizes  Council  Member  Rios.  She referenced  his signature  on the
  ordinance  dated November  9, 2021, when he was mayor  and allowed
  alcohol  sales at the park.  Where  he attends  :tunctions  drinking  at the park.
  She accuses him of using  this as a political  platform  for his re-election
  campaign  and points  out his lack of action  during  his eight years in
  council  and never  mentioning  the park during  the meetings.

  portion.
